_comment: The container entrypoint runs on Node inside the image, not in workerd, so it extends base.json (types: [node]) and EMITS dist/. The Dockerfile runs `node dist/container.js`. r2io.ts is listed in both projects on purpose: it is pure and is shared by the container and the tests. NOTE: container.ts is type-checked ONLY by `build` (tsc -b tsconfig.container.json), never by `typecheck` - the package's tsconfig.json deliberately excludes it because it targets Node, not workerd. Do not wire it into typecheck too.
